lines.say: This week, Israel's prime minister warned that an Iranian bomb would mean a second Holocaust.
But sixty-six years ago, in the Negev desert, Israel was secretly building its own.
Its prime minister told parliament the reactor was designed exclusively for peaceful purposes.
President Kennedy pressed him to let American inspectors in.
By early 1967, Israel had finished its first bomb.
In 1986, a technician named Mordechai Vanunu leaked photos from inside Dimona to a London newspaper.
Estimates now run past one hundred warheads. Israel has never admitted a single one.
The whole story is in the full video.
